professionalSummary.text: Platform engineer with 2.5 years of end-to-end ownership of a cloud platform (AWS, three accounts) for a logistics delivery division, responsible for production infrastructure changes, cost controls, and platform availability.
professionalSummary.witness: Owned the delivery division's cloud platform (AWS, three accounts) for two and a half years, deciding and executing production infrastructure changes myself as the named platform owner, with each change record carrying my approval and execution.

experienceHighlights.text: Decided and executed all production infrastructure changes as the named platform owner, with each change record carrying approval and execution by the candidate.
experienceHighlights.witness: Owned the delivery division's cloud platform (AWS, three accounts) for two and a half years, deciding and executing production infrastructure changes myself as the named platform owner, with each change record carrying my approval and execution.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained Terraform code, deployment pipelines for tracking and dispatch services, and cost controls including account budgets, tagging policy, and monthly right-sizing.
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the Terraform code, the deployment pipelines for the tracking and dispatch services and the cost controls (account budgets, the tagging policy and a monthly right-sizing pass) in shape.

experienceHighlights.text: Chaired the fortnightly change board with four service team leads, decided what went into the production window, and maintained meeting minutes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Chaired the fortnightly change board with the four service team leads; I decided what went into the production window and kept the minutes.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated changes with service teams and finance, documenting decision ownership: service configuration with service teams, budget approval with finance, platform and production window with the candidate.
experienceHighlights.witness: Worked changes through with the service teams and finance; the minutes record that service configuration stayed with the service teams, budget approval with finance, and the platform and the production window with me.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained current runbooks and documented limitations and hand-over points after every platform change.
experienceHighlights.witness: Two and a half years as the delivery division's platform owner: production changes, Terraform, cost controls and the change board.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Service-catalogue page listing the candidate as platform owner with a month of change records approved and executed under the candidate's user ID, including change-tool identifiers for traceability.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the service-catalogue page listing the candidate as platform owner and a month of change records approved and executed under the candidate's user id; change-tool identifiers are included so the records can be traced.

skills.text: AWS cloud platform management, Terraform, cost control (budgets, tagging, right-sizing), change management, cross-functional coordination with service teams and finance.
skills.witness: Kept the Terraform code, the deployment pipelines for the tracking and dispatch services and the cost controls (account budgets, the tagging policy and a monthly right-sizing pass) in shape.
